title: Resona

summary.en: A living showcase of creative technology grounded in pseudo-haptics — physical sensation simulated on glass screens where motion signals meaning before you read a word.
summary.jp: 疑似触覚にもとづくクリエイティブテクノロジーの実験場。文字を読む前に、動きと手応えだけで意味が伝わる。

mine: Designed and built a showcase of interactive experiences grounded in pseudo-haptics
Explored tactile feedback that signals meaning before the user reads any text

challenge.en: A screen has no weight and no friction, and a hand in front of a camera touches nothing. Resona still asks each gesture to feel like it meets something — a string that pulls back, ink that spreads, a sparkler that burns — before any label explains what to do. If the motion is wrong, no amount of text rescues it.
challenge.jp: 画面には重さも摩擦もなく、カメラの前の手は何にも触れていない。それでも Resona では、身ぶりが何かに当たった感覚を、説明より先に届けたい。引き返す弦、にじむ墨、指先で燃える花火。動きがうそをつけば、どんな説明文も取り返せない。

solution.en: Each study is built around a handful of verbs and nothing else: TENSION is reach, grab, pull, release, strum; INK is paint and pour; SPARKLER is pinch and burn. The camera follows the hand, and the response is carried by motion — how far something stretches, how it gives way, how long it lingers. Only the seven finished studies are published.
solution.jp: 習作ごとに、使う動詞を数個に絞った。TENSION（張）は伸ばす・つかむ・引く・放す・かき鳴らす。INK（墨）は描く・注ぐ。SPARKLER（灯）はつまむ・燃やす。カメラが手を追い、応答はすべて動きで返す。どこまで伸びるか、どう崩れるか、どれだけ残るか。公開しているのは、完成した 7 作だけ。

_notes: Thumbnail, still and preview come from the 2026-09 screen recordings (assets/resona/masters/).

cardKind.jp: クリエイティブテクノロジー · 擬似ハプティクス

cardLine.en: Motion signals meaning before the words arrive.
cardLine.jp: 言葉より先に、動きが意味を伝える。

oneLiner.en: Seven camera studies where your hands reach, pull and paint on screen — and the motion carries the meaning before any words do.
oneLiner.jp: カメラの前で手を伸ばし、引き、描く。7 つの習作で、言葉より先に動きが意味を伝える。
